Summary: Admin creates and deactivates staff accounts
Description: Deactivated user cannot obtain a JWT

Summary: Admin assigns a role to a user
Description: Role change takes effect on next login

Summary: Admin sees every artifact across all collections
Description: List returns artifacts regardless of curator

Summary: Admin reviews an artifact's change history
Description: History shows who changed what and when

Summary: Curator accessions a new artifact with a unique number
Description: Duplicate accession number is rejected with 409

Summary: Curator assigns an artifact to a collection and storage location
Description: Artifact detail shows both and location is required

Summary: Curator builds an exhibition from artifacts across collections
Description: An artifact can belong to several exhibitions

Summary: Curator filters artifacts by status material and date range
Description: Filtered list is paginated 20 per page

Summary: Restorer sees a queue of artifacts flagged for restoration
Description: Queue shows only OPEN and IN_PROGRESS jobs

Summary: Restorer logs a condition report with a grade and notes
Description: Report is timestamped and attributed to the inspector

Summary: Restorer opens updates and closes a restoration job
Description: Closing a job sets artifact status back to STORED

Summary: Any user logs in and sees only what their role permits
